multipliFlow.name: Multipli'Flow
multipliFlow.description: Line up identical fruits to open the way for the numbers: they cross the pipe and build multiplications.
multipliFlow.tagline: Open the way for the numbers

game.title: Multipli'Flow

status.play: Line up 3 identical fruits to clear the way for the numbers.
status.selected: Tile selected: touch a neighbouring tile to swap.
status.flowing: The numbers move on their own towards the pipe.
status.won: Well done! All the multiplications are solved.
status.chooseResult: Choose a result in the reservoir, then place it on the multiplication.
status.placeResult: Result chosen: tap the multiplication it belongs to.

messages.noAlignment: You need a line of at least 3 identical fruits.
messages.shuffleFailed: Could not reshuffle, restart the level.
messages.wrongResult: That is not the result of this multiplication: try again!

actions.restartAria: Restart this level with a new board

game.stuck: No move left: shuffle the tiles.

rotate.title: Turn your phone
rotate.text: Multipli'Flow is played in landscape, with its panels side by side.

won.title: Well done!
won.text: All the numbers went through the pipe and all the multiplications are solved.

howTo.step1: Touch a tile then its neighbour, or drag it. A swap is accepted only if it forms a line of 3 or more identical fruits.
howTo.step2: Lines disappear and free some cells. The numbers move on their own, cell by cell, towards the pipe.
howTo.step3: The numbers go through the pipe and form multiplications. Choose the right result in the reservoir: it goes down the pipe and locks onto the multiplication. A wrong result goes back up, with no penalty.

game.boardCleaned: The remaining fruits have vanished: the input board has finished its job.

details.summary: Free the numbers by lining up identical fruits and run a maths machine by picking the right results. Build your mental maths, logic and strategy.
details.objectives: Learn and consolidate the multiplication tables, build mental maths, plan moves ahead and solve problems.
steps: Line up at least three identical fruits.
Clear the way for the numbers to reach the pipe.
Watch the multiplications take shape.
Pick the right result in the upper reservoir.
Solve every operation to finish the level.
details.progression: Five levels of increasing difficulty. Boards are renewed to vary the game situations.
details.prerequisites: Recognise numbers and understand the idea of multiplication.
